comments.author: Maria
comments.body: No, crew size on aide ship doesn't slow down the main ship but that crew size affects water/food consumption. If u're sailing for long and carrying a big cargo then preferably, u would want as small a crew on aide ship as possible. That's how it works for me, and often i dismiss a few sailors on aide ship to help manage ration consumption better on long distance return trips.
